description: The deposit provides code, configurations and results for hierarchical economic control of a long-distance district-heating benchmark. It includes thermal scheduling, transient-head control, hydraulic models, calibration cases and solver records. The provider is Zaman, Yaseen; Wang, Yaran; Gao, Shan; Wu, Zhongbiao. Coverage: The described benchmark has a 50 km network. It is a simulation benchmark; no real service-area extent or observation dates are established. Access: The depositor publishes the record and its file listing on Zenodo. Only metadata was read; the files were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence and public access. Any separately cited input data retain their own terms. Limitations: The description is a depositor statement, not independent verification of results or reusable software. File completeness and execution remain untested. For simulation it supports reproducing thermo-hydraulic scheduling and fast pressure-control experiments. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes covers pipe-network modelling. This thematic link does not establish use by the authors.
